mapper.select: SELECT count(id) AS count,upload_status AS tabFlag FROM package_forecast WHERE is_deleted = FALSE GROUP BY upload_status

select pf.id, pf.code, pf.handover_no AS handoverNo, pf.platform_package_no AS platformPackageNo, pf.transport_no AS transportNo, pf.handover_status AS handoverStatus from package_forecast pf where pf.handover_no != '' and pf.handover_status not in ('signed_normal','closed','signed_failed') and pf.bill_date > #{dateTime}
